system.description:
Creates a 30ft-long x 7ft-high x 2ft-thick wall of fire. Deals 1d2 Fire damage for every 1ft of wall a victim passes through, and they gain the Burned Debuff.

This placed-terrain wall with per-foot damage scaling has no structural support in this system - resolve manually.

upgrades.description: +1d2 base damage (per foot traversed). The wall can be turned into a ring of fire. Duration is 5 rounds.
+1d2 base damage (per foot traversed). Creates a 50ft-long x 10ft-high x 3ft-thick wall. Duration is 10 rounds.
+1d2 base damage (per foot traversed). Creates a 100ft-long x 20ft-high x 5ft-thick wall. Duration is 15 rounds.
